# The title and the colours

**What it is.** The name at the top and the single colour theme of the whole picture.

## The title

| Part | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Text | NYX |
| Where to change it | `src/scene/header.svg` (the word between the `<text>` tags) |
| Title colour | Light silver `#e2e8f0` |
| Shape behind it | A dim slate blob `#394254`, so the light title reads on any background |

## One colour: Monochrome Platinum

The whole card is one colour family, light silver on near-black. Brighter silver means more activity.

| Use | Colour |
| --- | --- |
| Lowest bars (no activity) | `#1b1f28` |
| Low | `#394254` |
| Medium | `#58657d` |
| High | `#94a3b8` |
| Highest bars, numbers, radar outline | `#e2e8f0` |
| Background | near-black, `#11151c` to `#030406` |

## The one exception

The language donut and its list keep GitHub's own language colours (for example purple for C#, tan
for Rust). Silver cannot tell five slices apart, so this is the only place with colour.

## The fish

The koi keep their own colours. They are the only other colour in the picture.
